summary: Example inventory setting unique certificates per host as host variables: `gateway_tls_cert`/`gateway_tls_key` on each `[automationgateway]` host, `web_server_ssl_cert`/`_key` on each `[automationcontroller]` host and `automationhub_ssl_cert`/`_key` on each `[automationhub]` host.
questions: How do I set different TLS certificates per AAP node in the inventory?
Example inventory with per-host gateway certificates
Where do I put certificate variables for each controller node?

answer_card.title: Per-host certificates in the inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationgateway]
gateway0.example.com gateway_tls_cert=/path/to/cert0 gateway_tls_key=/path/to/key0
gateway1.example.com gateway_tls_cert=/path/to/cert1 gateway_tls_key=/path/to/key1

[automationcontroller]
controller0.example.com web_server_ssl_cert=/path/to/cert0 web_server_ssl_key=/path/to/key0

[automationhub]
hub0.example.com automationhub_ssl_cert=/path/to/cert0 automationhub_ssl_key=/path/to/key0
```
Each cert needs a SAN matching the load balancer FQDN.
